title: Find the Interest First
text:
The interest is the difference between what was paid back and what was borrowed:

$$I = A - P$$

title: Calculate the Difference
text:
Total paid back = R10 160
Original loan = R8 000

$$I = R10\,160 - R8\,000$$

title: The Interest Amount
text:
$$I = R10\,160 - R8\,000 = R2\,160$$

The interest paid over 3 years was R2 160.
